message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace_snmp.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "testing/fuzzing/snmp_parse_args_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 40, "var": "argv", "code": "argv[i] = af_gb_get_null_terminated(&data, &size);", "note": "Attacker-controlled input bytes are split into 75-byte null-terminated argv strings; one string is the '-Y' option and the next is its optarg config line '[snmp]'."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "snmplib/snmp_parse_args.c", "function": "netsnmp_parse_args", "line": 278, "var": "optarg", "code": "netsnmp_config_remember(optarg);", "note": "The '-Y' option passes its optarg (the attacker-controlled config line '[snmp]') to netsnmp_config_remember, which strdup's it into the memory list."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "snmplib/read_config.c", "function": "netsnmp_config_remember_in_list", "line": 733, "var": "(*mem)->line", "code": "(*mem)->line = strdup(line);", "note": "The config line is stored as a heap-allocated string in the read_config_memory list for later processing."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "snmplib/snmp_api.c", "function": "init_snmp", "line": 928, "var": "memorylist", "code": "read_premib_configs();", "note": "init_snmp (called from snmp_parse_args) invokes read_premib_configs, which processes all remembered config lines."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "snmplib/read_config.c", "function": "read_premib_configs", "line": 1119, "var": "when", "code": "netsnmp_config_process_memories_when(PREMIB_CONFIG, 0);", "note": "Processes the remembered config lines with when=PREMIB_CONFIG."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "snmplib/read_config.c", "function": "netsnmp_config_process_memory_list", "line": 719, "var": "mem->line", "code": "snmp_config_when(mem->line, when);", "note": "Each remembered line is passed to snmp_config_when; the attacker line '[snmp]' is a type header with no second token."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "snmplib/read_config.c", "function": "snmp_config_when", "line": 618, "var": "lptr", "code": "lptr = read_config_get_handlers(cptr + 1);", "note": "cptr='[snmp]' is a type header; read_config_get_handlers('snmp') returns the registered 'snmp' handlers (non-NULL)."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "snmplib/read_config.c", "function": "snmp_config_when", "line": 625, "var": "cptr", "code": "cptr = strtok_r(NULL, SNMP_CONFIG_DELIMETERS, &st);", "note": "There is no second token after '[snmp]', so strtok_r returns NULL."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "snmplib/read_config.c", "function": "read_config_find_handler", "line": 519, "var": "token", "code": "if (!strcasecmp(token, lptr->config_token))", "note": "read_config_find_handler is called with token=NULL; strcasecmp(NULL, ...) dereferences NULL, causing a NULL-pointer dereference crash."}
]
EOF
echo "created trace"` executed with exit code 0.
